sources.entry: Adium - Free instant messaging application for Mac OS X. Connect to AIM, MSN, SMPP, Yahoo and more. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Adium
summary.one_liner: Adium is a free, open-source instant messaging client for macOS that connects to XMPP (Jabber), IRC and other chat services.
use_cases: chat with friends across several IM services from one app
connect to XMPP or Jabber accounts on a Mac
merge contacts from different chat accounts into one person
summary.what_it_does:
Adium is a free, open-source instant messaging application for macOS. It connects to many IM services, including XMPP (Jabber), IRC, AIM, MSN, Yahoo and SMPP, using the libpurple protocol library. Chats appear in tabbed windows with themeable WebKit message views. It integrates with the macOS Contacts app and lets users merge contacts so each one represents a person rather than an account. It also supports OTR encryption, file transfer, visual notifications via Growl and macOS Notification Center, and Xtras for customization. The page states Adium does not host any IM services; it is a third-party client for services run by others.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
platforms: Mac OS X 10.2 through 10.7.5 (older Adium versions)
notable: Open source under GNU GPL, built with Cocoa and libpurple
Combined contacts merge multiple accounts into one person
OTR encryption and macOS Contacts/Notification Center integration
caveats: Mac only; older Adium versions support only older Mac OS X releases (e.g. 1.5.10.1 needs Mac OS X 10.7.5 or newer)
Does not host any IM services; depends on third-party services
